hooks.command: f=$(jq -r ".tool_input.file_path // .tool_response.filePath"); case "$f" in "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR"/tasks/*.py) lint=$(cd "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR" && NO_COLOR=1 ruff check --no-cache --output-format concise "$f" 2>&1) || { echo "ruff check failed on $f:" >&2; echo "$lint" >&2; exit 2; }; out=$(PYTHON_COLORS=0 python3 "$CLAUDE_PROJECT_DIR/tasks/check.py" 2>&1) || { echo "tasks/check.py failed after editing $f:" >&2; echo "$out" >&2; exit 2; } ;; esac
